# GitHub Copilot Engineering Instructions

## Core Principles
1. **Performance**: Keep the application fast, responsive, and lightweight. Use concurrent data fetching (`Promise.all`) and ensure instantaneous user feedback on clicks with zero artificial delays.
2. **Bilingual Arabic/English**: Maintain clean Modern Standard Arabic (RTL) and English (LTR) with no awkward code-switching or directionality corruption.
3. **Robust Security**: Enforce publisher authorization for content mutations and validate all inputs with strict typing and UUID validation.
4. **Clean Code**: Follow modern Next.js App Router patterns, Tailwind CSS styling, and strict TypeScript types.
